mentions.name: Spine
mentions.description: Spine is a platform for agentic applications, aiming to make them feel more like traditional software: something you can reason about, inspect, reuse, and distribute.
mentions.problem: Agentic applications currently don't feel like traditional software — they lack the reasonability, inspectability, reusability, and distributability of conventional programs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building Spine, a platform for agentic applications because I want agentic applications to feel more like traditional software: something you can reason about, inspect, reuse, and distribute.
mentions.author: fla
